description: Aggregate your saved library by user-declared genre tags. Scans all saved tracks and albums, joins each item's artists against your tag sidecar (see tag_management), and reports per-genre track/album counts plus the contributing artists. Genres are unavailable from Spotify itself, so only artists you have tagged appear here.

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: library_genre_report
